items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: I worked in the Black Cat on Rampart, a couple of doors from Tom Anderson's. Because I remember we used to eat in Tom Anderson's late... I knew him I only saw him yeah because I worked as I say only one door away from him

ctx.x: I think he was mostly in the theater.

But the piano player, I know, I'm trying to think of what, I worked in the Black Cat on Rampart, a couple of doors from Tom Anderson's. Because I remember we used to eat in Tom Anderson's late, you know, in the morning.
